intent: A dark, monochrome ranked breakdown: a share strip that grows segment by segment, rows that land with counting figures and filling bars, and a period switch that re-sorts rows on a spring.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: motion values and useTransform for counting figures and path geometry (no per-frame React setState), layoutId for selection, AnimatePresence for swaps
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for headlines, font-sans (Geist) with tnum, font-mono (Geist Mono) for small labels

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 14px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow, p-4 (@md p-6), @container root
layout.header: title over counting total | period switch; caption below
layout.rows: rank, name, optional delta (≥ @sm), amount, share %; 4px bar under, indented to the name

color.approach: rank as lightness: leader in the accent (default theme ink), others the ink at 62/44/30/20/14%; green/red only on deltas

motion.order: card → title/total/switch/caption 60ms apart → strip segments grow in rank order (0.22s, 50ms apart) → rows land (0.16s, 50ms apart) → each row's figures count and its bar fills 0.22s after landing
motion.figures: count from 0 over 0.75s with 6px blur settle
motion.periodSwitch: rows re-sort with layout='position' spring 500/40, rank numbers roll, figures and bars tween without stagger, segments retarget together
motion.implementation: figures are useTransform of motion values; first-view delays drop to 0 after onAnimationComplete
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades, values set instantly, no layout springs

accessibility: period switch is a radiogroup with arrow keys
counting figures expose an sr-only final value
share strip is aria-hidden; rows carry every number

content.brand: Kiln & Co., a small ceramics shop
content.channels: Online store, Instagram, Email, Wholesale, Studio shop
content.story: in the last 7 days a café's wholesale order lifts Wholesale above Email
